scope: Conditional reused-history HYG-minus-LQD H5 information screen only: two fixed Ridge fits, one paired bootstrap, zero native accounts

reviewed_evidence.source_formula: Fixed 20 completed source-session log total-return difference from original HYG/LQD raw closes plus cash dividends on ex-dividend dates, ending at each Stage1 signal date; retrospective adjusted close is diagnostic only.
reviewed_evidence.paired_stationary_bootstrap: 63-session mean block, 10000 draws, seed 20261023, one-sided alpha 0.025/28; positive coordinate coefficient and full/half/lower-bound improvements all required.

scientific_boundary: Current Yahoo cash-dividend event amounts lack certified historical first-public and revision vintages.
